Metadata.title: Next.js Full-stack Starter
Metadata.description: A production-oriented starter for multilingual full-stack Next.js applications.

Home.title: Next.js Full-stack Starter
Home.description: A production-oriented foundation for multilingual Next.js applications.

DesignSystem.title: Design system foundation
DesignSystem.description: A focused reference for semantic tokens, accessible primitives, reusable states, and bidirectional behavior.

tokens.title: Tokens and typography
tokens.description: Semantic color, type, geometry, and elevation remain consistent across themes.
tokens.surface: The same semantic component contract works on both token surfaces.

typography.heading: Clear multilingual hierarchy
typography.body: Body text stays comfortable to read in both English and Arabic.
typography.label: Compact interface label

controls.title: Controls
controls.description: Stable variants, sizes, accessible states, and explicit directional icons.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Labels, descriptions, validation, controls, and logical alignment compose predictably.
forms.name: Name
forms.nameDescription: This example demonstrates descriptive help text.

feedback.title: Feedback and surfaces
feedback.description: Status meaning combines text, icons, and semantic tone rather than color alone.
feedback.defaultDescription: Use the neutral alert for contextual information.
feedback.errorDescription: The operation needs attention before it can proceed.

card.title: Composed card
card.description: Header, content, and footer remain separate semantic regions.

overlays.title: Overlays and transient feedback
overlays.description: Radix primitives retain keyboard focus, dismissal, direction, and shared layering.
overlays.dialogDescription: The dialog has a visible title and returns focus when it closes.
overlays.confirmDescription: This demonstrates a destructive confirmation without business logic.

patterns.title: Reusable states
patterns.description: Small compositions cover loading, empty, error, forbidden, and not-found experiences.
patterns.emptyDescription: Add the first item or return to the previous view.
patterns.errorDescription: Try the operation again or return later.
patterns.forbiddenDescription: Your current access does not include this content.
patterns.notFoundDescription: The requested content is unavailable or has moved.

direction.title: Bidirectional content
direction.description: Logical layout follows the locale while identifiers and user-authored content declare their own direction.
direction.userTextExample: This field uses automatic direction — هذا الحقل يحدد الاتجاه تلقائيًا.
